images.author: CDC / Charles D. Humphrey
images.why: Caption confirms a colourised TEM of clustered norovirus virions. Purple particles against orange provide strong contrast. This direct URL is the preview; the page offers a 7.03 MB original whose download URL could not be verified.

images.author: CDC / Charles D. Humphrey, PhD
images.why: Caption confirms a colourised TEM of a norovirus cluster. Blue round particles against a pale background. This is the preview; the page offers a 10.06 MB original whose download URL could not be verified.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Caption identifies a colourised SEM of blue RSV virions shedding from human lung epithelial A549 cells; yellow dots are antibody/gold labels. Filamentous particles suit a detailed crop. Image URL requests a 3000-pixel version.

images.author: NIAID
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies three Epstein–Barr virus particles colourised pink. Strong colour and distinct virions make this a promising card image. The source caption and licence were verified; the original-file download could not be independently verified.
